 Atletico Madrid 1-2 Barcelona 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Metropolitano Stadium 
 You can never underestimate the strength of this Barcelona attack.
 Atleti will feel really hard done by here. They need to find an equaliser quickly or Barca could run away with this.

 Atletico Madrid 1-2 Barcelona 
 At the other end Alexander Sorloth gets the ball into the box out wide, but his shot/cross is straight at the keeper.

 Atletico Madrid 1-2 Barcelona 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Metropolitano Stadium 
 Lamine Yamal with a perfectly placed ball into Fermin Lopez gives Barca the lead. 
 A great assist and a lovely finish. 
 Atletico players are utterly deflated. 
 18 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Atletico Madrid 1-2 Barcelona published at 21:27 GMT 21:27 GMT 
 Fermin Lopez (66 mins) 
 Barcelona turn it around! It's harsh on Atletico who had just been building, but the champions show their quality.
 Lamine Yamal plays a perfect ball right into the path of Fermin Lopez in the box who just has to slide it past Jan Oblak.
 103 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing

 Atletico Madrid 1-1 Barcelona

 Atletico Madrid 1-1 Barcelona 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Metropolitano Stadium 
 It feels like the two sides have switched this half. 
 In the first half, it was Atletico with all the possession and Barca trying to catch them on the break. 
 This half, it feels like it's shifted to the opposite.

 Atletico Madrid 1-1 Barcelona 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Metropolitano Stadium 
 Atleti break and Alvarez is left one on one with the keeper. 
 This time he tries to dink the ball into the net but it goes over the crossbar. 
 He'll be disappointed with the opportunities he's missed tonight.

 Atletico Madrid 1-1 Barcelona 
 This game is set up for a Julian Alvarez winner ain't it? The forward latches onto a ball over the top and shoots early, trying to lob the keeper, but his effort lands on the roof of the net.
 Couple of jeers towards Alvarez from some home supporters.
